source.caveat: Their GenMol is initialized from the full UNSCORED fragment pool rather than the original GenMol task-oracle prescreen, so this is 'GenMol (that paper's implementation), PMO-1K', not the official GenMol 1K result. That is what makes it the right comparator for our no-prescreen lane. 1K results are averaged over three random seeds. valsartan is excluded from their 22-task aggregate as unstable.
